title: operation_status payload
description: Sent by the daemon to report progress and terminal outcomes. Terminal states (succeeded, failed, cancelled) are immutable on the platform: a conflicting terminal report receives an error message, a repeat of the same terminal state is a no-op. Failed results carry {"error": {"code", "message"}}; diagnostic.noop successes carry {"noop": true}. On replay, a locally accepted diagnostic operation can start; a locally running operation with an unknown outcome must not be rerun and is reported failed with code interrupted_unknown_outcome.
